# Copilot instructions

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
	- Create a simple React app that fetches weather from Open-Meteo and shows temperature, wind speed, wind direction and humidity based on latitude & longitude inputs.

- [x] Scaffold the Project
	- Used Create React App to scaffold the project in this folder.

- [x] Customize the Project
	- Implemented `src/App.js` with a form for latitude/longitude and an API call to Open-Meteo.
	- Added `src/App.css` tweaks for layout and a simple weather card.
	- Added README.md with run instructions.

- [ ] Install Required Extensions
	- No VS Code extensions required beyond defaults.

- [x] Compile the Project
	- Installed dependencies and axios. Run `npm run build` to validate compilation when convenient.

- [ ] Create and Run Task
	- No automated tasks were added. A task.json can be added later to run `npm start`.

- [x] Launch the Project
	- Dev server can be started with `npm start`.

- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete
	- README.md added. This file documents the steps already performed.
